Frequently asked questions

Which regulations do these courses follow?
  • OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER Annual Refresher - RCRA TSD Operations Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910.120(p) and 29 CFR 1926.65(p).
  • OSHA 8-Hour HAZWOPER and Safe Ammonia Handling Refresher Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910.120(e) and 29 CFR 1926.65(e).
  • OSHA 24-Hour HAZWOPER - RCRA TSD Operations Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910.120(p) and 29 CFR 1926.65(p).
  • OSHA HAZWOPER and RCRA Hazardous Waste Management Technician Safety Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910.120(e) and 29 CFR 1926.65(e) and EPA Regulations 40 CFR Part 261 and Part 262.
How long does HAZWOPER for RCRA TSD & Hazardous Waste Technicians training take?
  • OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER Annual Refresher - RCRA TSD Operations Training: 8 hours.
  • OSHA 8-Hour HAZWOPER and Safe Ammonia Handling Refresher Training: 8 hours.
  • OSHA 24-Hour HAZWOPER - RCRA TSD Operations Training: 24 hours.
  • OSHA HAZWOPER and RCRA Hazardous Waste Management Technician Safety Training: 40 hours.

Training is self-paced, so you can stop and pick up where you left off at any time.

How long do I have to finish?

You get a 3-month completion timeline, 1-year access to training materials.

Do I get a certificate?

Yes. You can download your certificate of completion as soon as you pass the final exam.

The certificate is valid for 12 months before a refresher is required.

Can I take the training on my phone?

Yes. The training is 100% online and works on phones, tablets and computers, 24 hours a day.

Can I buy training for my whole team?

Yes. Enter the number of seats at checkout. Team pricing starts at 2 seats and goes up to 10% off for 501–1,000 seats. For larger orders or invoicing, call 1‑866‑429‑6742.

Is the training available in Spanish?

Yes. All 4 courses are available in English and Spanish.

How do I start my course after I pay?

Right after checkout you'll get an email with your receipt and your login for the learning portal. Sign in at hazwoper-osha.com to begin.

Who provides the training?

Courses are delivered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC on its online learning portal at hazwoper-osha.com. Questions? Call 1‑866‑429‑6742.

What is the refund policy?

See the refund policy on hazwoper-osha.com, or call us before you start a course.
